title: Compact crosslink checklist — ad-hoc coverage matrix
body:
Compact crosslink checklist (one-page ad-hoc tracker)

Columns: ID | Item | Owner | Stakeholders | ETA | Status | Notes | Related ticket/PR

1 | Emergency fallback validation for EU region (night batches) | Miguel Reyes | eng-sre, infra | 2032-02-18 | in_progress | quick smoke to confirm prefix cache behavior under burst; partial results on eu-batch-3 | JIRA: SRE-904
2 | Canary routing policy audit (dedicated -> hosted fallback) | Asha Patel | product-hosted-api, platform-eng | 2032-02-19 | todo | need list of recent rollouts that used fallback; ask console team for route logs | JIRA: PLT-312
3 | Temp override list for critical customers (whitelist keys) | Priya Nair | cs, acct-mgmt | 2032-02-12 | done | applied for 3 customers, confirm billing tags next week | Billing ticket: BILL-78
4 | Quick telemetry gap: token-level cost for embeddings route | Sofia Kim | observability, optimize | 2032-02-20 | in_review | draft query in /observability/queries; missing tags for older runs -> flagged | GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/88
5 | Handback checklist for on-call switchover (weekend) | Daniel Chen | sre, product-ops | 2032-02-14 | done | left notes in #oncall-handback; ensure runbook link included | Confluence: /display/SRE/Runbooks#weekend-swap
6 | Lightweight capacity cushion estimate for SE Asia pilot | Miguel Reyes | infra, sales-apac | 2032-02-25 | todo | rough numbers only — need region-specific GPU days and burst assumptions | JIRA: CAP-61
7 | Small integration test: kv-cache eviction when quantized-variants used | Asha Patel | serving-runtime, applied-ml | 2032-02-22 | in_progress | intermittent failure — seem tied to model-variant aliasing; replicate locally | GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1401
8 | Outreach list for customers affected by transient throttles | Priya Nair | cs, legal | 2032-02-16 | in_progress | draft email in /templates/ops/notice-throttle; waiting legal review | Slack: #cs-legal-thread-294
9 | Mini audit: recent private deploys missing audit-log retention labels | Sofia Kim | security-and-compliance, private-deployments | 2032-02-21 | todo | security asked for 30/90/365 buckets; quick sweep script usable | JIRA: COMPL-207
10 | One-off: confirm fallback burn-rate alert thresholds for launch day | Daniel Chen | product-ops, observability | 2032-02-18 | blocked | need historical burn-rate baseline from finance; pinged @finance-ops | JIRA: OBS-99

Quick notes/to-dos:
- Priority order: 1,7,4,8 (shortest unblock path). If Miguel gets EU batch smoke green, drop #10 blockage.
- Action: Miguel to post eu-batch-3 logs to Confluence page by 2032-02-16.
- Action: Asha to fork the local kv-cache test and add deterministic seeds by 2032-02-15.
- Weekly check-in cadence: Tue standup -> 10m crosswalk until all items closed.
- If any item becomes "urgent" move to "ops-hotlist" and notify CSMs via #cs-ops.

Open questions / unresolved:
- Do we keep the temp whitelist after the pilot ends? (Priya) -> decision owner: acct-mgmt, due 2032-02-28.
- Which historical window should we use for burn-rate baselining? 30d vs 90d (Finance input needed).

Notes to self (Asha):
- This is intentionally compact — intended to be pasted into Slack summary for stakeholders.
- Keep this doc as the single source for weekend handoffs until we standardize into the new ops sheet.
- Later: convert rows 1/4/7 into small Jira epics if they grow beyond checklist scope.

Latest activity log (short):
- 2032-02-12: Priya applied temp whitelist for 3 customers; added billing tags pending.
- 2032-02-13: Daniel pushed weekend handoff notes to Confluence.
- 2032-02-15: Asha created local reproducer for kv-cache intermittent; running longer jobs overnight.
- 2032-02-16: Miguel posted initial EU batch logs to Confluence (link above).

End of compact checklist.
